qualifications.name: Bachelor of Nursing
notes: Programme scope: Programme code(s): SHBBN.

Eligibility explanation: NSC 36 with adequate achievement in Life Sciences, Mathematics, English and Physical Sciences, excluding Life Orientation; selection test and physical assessment are required.

Document checklist: Upload an ID or passport, Grade 11 final results or Grade 12 results/matric certificate, academic record and certificate of good conduct if previously registered at a tertiary institution, international study/residence/medical-insurance/SAQA documents where applicable, and proof of the R100 application fee.

Application method: South African undergraduate applicants use the UNIVEN online application wizard with a South African ID number, cellphone number, email address and card payment details. Previous online applicants must download the form from the website and submit it with supporting documents.
Closing-date context: The 2024 brochure states that applications for admission closed on 27 September 2023 for that intake; confirm the current-cycle closing date on UNIVEN before applying.
Application safety: Use univen.ac.za and official UNIVEN admissions contacts only. The brochure says no email applications are entertained for current South African online applicants.
Source note: Official 2024 undergraduate brochure; verify current intake dates, selection steps and document rules on UNIVEN before submitting.
